zh: 航空短訊彙整：西南航空洛杉磯飛奧蘭多航班　三組搖滾樂團輪番機上演出、美國航空冬季七條國際航線陸續開航　涵蓋東京、阿姆斯特丹與波多、聯航申請限制飛往芝加哥歐海爾（ORD）航班　疏導壅塞後措施已解除
en: Aviation briefs: Three rock bands perform aboard Southwest flight to Orlando; American Airlines adds seven international routes across winter season; United’s targeted O’Hare ground stop expires after congestion relief

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Google收購精神航空內部資料案讓步：排除員工醫療與安全報告、工會撤回異議、美軍AFRICOM資助Merlin 於摩洛哥測試Cessna Caravan無人傷患後送
en: Aviation briefs: Google agrees to privacy safeguards in Spirit Airlines data deal; US AFRICOM Awards Merlin $500K Contract for Autonomous CASEVAC Test in Morocco

zh: 全美航班於01:15 UTC恢復，停飛與通訊問題有關
en: US flights resumed at 01:15 UTC after a nationwide ground stop over a communications issue.

zh: 美軍AFRICOM資助Merlin於摩洛哥測試無人機傷患後送
en: US AFRICOM funds Merlin for autonomous CASEVAC test in Morocco

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Vertical獲AS9100品質認證、Quantum Systems稱德軍無人機復飛、SpiceJet傳欠費取消杜拜出發四航班
en: Aviation briefs: Vertical earns AS9100 certification; Quantum Systems says German military drones resume flights; SpiceJet reportedly cancels four Dubai departures over unpaid fees

zh: 英國法院裁定 Global Airlines 強制清算
en: UK court orders compulsory liquidation for Global Airlines

zh: 土耳其軍用S-70墜毀，4名軍職人員死亡
en: Four Turkish service members killed in military S-70 helicopter crash.

zh: 五起獨立航空事件：客艙煙霧、擋風玻璃破裂等
en: Five independent aviation incidents include cabin smoke and other events.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：澤倫斯基稱 Starshield 速限再現，影響攔截俄羅斯噴射動力無人機；波蘭正敲定向烏克蘭移交MiG-29戰機，換取接觸烏方無人機及反無人機技術
en: Aviation briefs: Zelenskyy says renewed Starshield speed cap hinders interception of Russian jet-powered drones; Poland is finalizing MiG-29 transfer plans to Ukraine for drone and counter-drone technology access

zh: Sikorsky S-70直升機墜毀，4名土耳其軍人死亡
en: Four Turkish service members killed in military Sikorsky S-70 helicopter crash.
